This guide shows a minimal call to `run_scd_analysis()` with multiple studies.

## Data

Combine observations in one table with study, case, time, phase, and outcome
columns. Assign distinct case identifiers across studies. Add grouping or
covariate columns as needed.

## Fit a model

Read a CSV file containing the required columns.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(scdbayes)
data <- read.csv("data.csv")
result <- run_scd_analysis(data, options = list(family = "gaussian"))
result$diagnostics
```

The result contains the fitted model, summaries, and diagnostics. Inspect
diagnostics before interpreting results. See `?run_scd_analysis` for arguments.
